documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: AksharChem (India) Limited reported financial and operational performance for Q1 FY20 alongside an investor presentation in August 2019. Management highlighted that revenues and volumes were impacted during the quarter due to an economic slowdown and softening prices. The company outlines ongoing expansion plans across organic pigments, dyes and intermediates, and specialty chemicals. Furthermore, management remains optimistic about long-term growth prospects driven by industry opportunities and stringent environmental regulations in China. AksharChem (India) Limited reported its financial and operational highlights for Q1 FY20 in an investor presentation, noting that revenues and volumes were impacted due to an economic slowdown and softening prices.

guidance.claim: Management expects capacity utilization of H-Acid to increase slightly going forward.
guidance.quote: Going ahead, we expect a little higher utilization of the capacity.

guidance.claim: Management expects the precipitated silica greenfield project at Dahej to commence commercial production in the second half of FY2020.
guidance.quote: This is new Greenfield project at Dahej with a capacity of 10,000 MTPA, commercial production is expected to start in the second half of FY2020.

guidance.claim: Management projects a topline growth of around 15% moving forward.
guidance.quote: In terms of topline, we feel we will continue to achieve around 15% or so in topline growth.

guidance.claim: Management states that EBITDA margins can be expected roughly between 10% and 12% under current market conditions.
guidance.quote: The bottom line with reference to EBITDA can be expected roughly only between 10% and 12% as it goes now, if this market persists.

guidance.claim: Management expects CPC green capacity utilization to be around 85% post-expansion.
guidance.quote: Post expanded capacity, looking at the current market situation, we expect it to be around ~ 85%.

demand_outlook.claim: Volumes were impacted on the back of slowdown in the economy which led to reduction in demand from the end-user industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Volumes were impacted on the back of slowdownin the economy which led to reduction in demand from the end‐user industries

demand_outlook.claim: Textile industry in India is projected to grow at over 10% CAGR over the next 5 years.
demand_outlook.quote: Textile industry in India is projected to grow at over 10% CAGR over the next 5 years

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that revenues were impacted during the quarter due to low volumes and softening prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenues were impacted due to low volumes and softening of prices

demand_outlook.claim: Management describes the current market for H-Acid and Vinyl Sulphone as average and lackluster.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, as I said, our efforts are towards getting the precipitated silica plant to start immediately. After that, depending on the market situation, we will look at the pigment expansion, we have kept it ready we may go in for the pigment green, another Greenfield expansion, what we had originally thought of.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that Indian dyestuff exports are growing at 15% to 20% while global textile industry growth is 3% to 5%.
demand_outlook.quote: The textile industry globally is not growing more than may be ~3% to 5% but the Indian dye stuff exports are growing at ~15% to 20% at least, so India is gaining share at the expense of China and there is an opportunity.

capex_expansion.claim: Proposed expansion plans include adding 480 TPA for CPC Green, 1,200 TPA for H Acid, and 10,000 TPA for Precipitated Silica.
capex_expansion.quote: ORGANIC PIGMENTS CPC Green 1,920 480 2,400 DYES & INTERMEDIATES H Acid ‐ 1,200 1,200 SPECIALTY CHEMICALS Precipitated Silica ‐ 10,000 10,000

capex_expansion.claim: The expansion of CPC green by 480 MTPA was completed in the first half of financial year 2019.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expansion of CPC green of 480 MTPA was completed in the first half of financial year 2019, this has resulted in an increase of our green capacity from 920 to 2,400 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed the H-Acid project in the first half of the financial year with an available capacity of 1,200 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to H-Acid expansion, the company has completed this project in the first half of this financial year. This is a new product the company has added in the dye intermediates basket. Current capacity available is 1,200 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital expenditure spent on the precipitated silica project till date is approximately Rs. 39 Crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex till date is Rs.39 Crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital expenditure spent on the H-Acid project till date is Rs. 38 Crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Rs.38 Crores of capex till date.

capex_expansion.claim: Total planned capital expenditure for the precipitated silica project infrastructure is around Rs. 80 to Rs. 85 Crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The amount of Rs.80 to Rs. 85 Crores is because of the infrastructure we are doing ahead of time for future phases of expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margins have remained stable in the range of 35% to 37% for the last few quarters.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margins have remained stable in the range of 35%‐37% for the last few quarters

margins_costs.claim: Revenues were impacted due to low volumes and softening of prices.
margins_costs.quote: Revenues were impacted due to low volumes and softening of prices

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margins were impacted by high volatility of crude prices and currency fluctuations.
margins_costs.quote: Our gross profit margins were impacted on back of high volatility of crude prices along with currency fluctuations, which was beyond our control.

margins_costs.claim: The company spent Rs. 16 Crores towards pollution treatment expenses for FY2019.
margins_costs.quote: We have spent Rs.16 Crores towards pollution treatment expenses for the FY2019.

margins_costs.claim: The lack of backward integration into making acids impacts EBITDA margins by 2% to 3% compared to peers.
margins_costs.quote: Some of our peers have their own acids, so this probably impacts 2% to 3% of the EBITDA margins.

orders_capacity.claim: AksharChem is the largest exporter of vinyl sulphone in India with approximately 45% share in exports of this product.
orders_capacity.quote: Largest exporter of VINYL SULPHONE in India with ~45% share in exports of this product

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for production stood at 11,400 TPA with a capacity utilisation of 74% in Q1 FY20.
Current capacity utilization on a blended basis stands at 85%.
orders_capacity.quote: Current capacity utilization on blended basis stands at 85%.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Rs. 3.50 per equity share for FY2018-2019.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to announce that the Board of Directors have recommended a final dividend of Rs.3.50 per equity share which is 35% of face value of Rs.10 per equity share for the year FY2018-2019.

capital_allocation.claim: The company borrowed Rs. 11.5 Crores as a working capital loan during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has borrowed Rs.11.5 Crores during the year, this is the working capital loan, however on net level, our company is a net cash company.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt to equity ratio of the company as of March 2019 stands at 0.04x.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt to equity of the company as on March 2019, stands at 0.04x.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company noted that it takes over 3 years to get environmental clearances from the government.
risks_headwinds.quote: It takes over 3 years to get Environmental Clearances from the Government

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted risks including international and Indian economic performance, competition, implementation of strategies, and market risk exposure.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implementitsstrategy,theCompany’sfuturelevelsofgrowthandexpansion,technologicalimplementation,changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced teething troubles with quality and yield upon starting the manufacturing of H-Acid, leading to one-off losses.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our company started manufacturing of H-Acid where initially we faced teething troubles with quality and yield. This led to one-off losses.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply disruption of certain input raw materials resulted in an increased cost of production.
risks_headwinds.quote: Also there was disruption in supply of a few of the input raw materials resulting in increased cost of production.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the long-term outlook looks bright and the company will continue to deliver great returns for shareholders.
management_commitments.quote: We believe our long term outlook looks bright and we will continue to deliver great returns for our shareholders

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a continued focus on widening and deepening marketing reach and delivering great returns for shareholders.
management_commitments.quote: Expanding footprints: Essential to widen and deepen marketing reach to make the most ofthe unaddressed opportunities

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to commence commercial production of the precipitated silica project in the current year before December.
management_commitments.quote: So once that happens, then we will focus on pigment expansion, but not dye intermediates largely.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to decide on the next project plan after silica by Diwali.
management_commitments.quote: So hopefully, our plan of the next project after that will be decided by this Diwali.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
